notes.title: Hotfixes for 1.0d!
notes.content:
Hey folks, some bug reports coming in, here's what's fixed as of now:
- Hard mode added to Forever mode... for those who need it
- Stages now displaying correctly in Forever mode
- Achievements for Chibisatan and Syndril retested and working
- Quit button added for those working on achievements or just want to restart
- Adjusted pencil sharpening game as some folks were having difficulty in keypresses
